architecture.text: Behindthe ResponseSeeing a hand. Sensing a cup. Coordinating a physical response.From a gesture to movement.CameraHand-gesture inputMediaPipe + PythonRecognise the gestureBleak / BLESend the movement commandESP32Arduino C++ controls the driverMotor driver + motorsMove the companionThe cup sets the state.Weight readings from the load cell and documented HX711 amplifier reach the ESP32. BLE carries cup status to the Python control program.Load cell / amplifier → ESP32 → BLE / PythonCup presentCUP_ONGesture control is enabled.Cup removedCUP_OFFGesture control is disabled. Python coordinates Unity’s drink animation until the cup returns.Reported system architecture, not live telemetry. The team’s 10-second demo interval was a technical test setting, not a validated everyday reminder schedule.
